key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities across sectors
RBA signals continued hikes despite surging unemployment, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences a 'trapdoor' move, weakening materially against USD
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline, with Victoria hit hardest
Gold exploration sector shows strong results: Aurum 155g/t hit, Zenith six-for-six in WA corridor
$2.7B in capital raises flooding the market, pressuring small/mid-cap miners
Data centre boom straining energy supply, creating a potential 'energy bust' risk
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/consumer discretionary
Global AI/tech momentum continues (Nvidia, AMD, Salesforce) but limited direct ASX exposure
Over half of Australian renters financially stressed, pressuring consumer spending

sectors.trend: Mixed: large-cap miners under pressure from AUD weakness and global risk-off, but junior gold explorers showing strong assay results. $2.7B cap raise wave diluting small-caps.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors (AUR.AX, ZEN.AX, KUN.AX) attract speculative flows; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from falling commodity demand signals and AUD depreciation. Cap raises create overhang on ASX 200/300 miners.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking cycle continues despite unemployment surge, supporting NIMs but raising credit-loss concerns. Renters' financial stress (50%+) threatens mortgage portfolios.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider spreads but face rising NPL risk. Bond yield climb pressures ASX 200 valuations broadly.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating structural energy demand but supply constraints risk a 'bust'. AI data centre development proceeding without permits signals regulatory gaps.
sectors.implications: Energy producers (SOL.AX, WDS.AX) and utilities (AGL.AX, GPG.AX) face demand upside but infrastructure bottleneck risk. Watch for policy intervention.

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to 40-year decline; CBD commercial tower listed at $40m signals softening. Renters' stress supports rental demand but caps capital growth.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) under pressure from falling valuations. Residential builders (MPL.AX, GPT.AX) face demand deterioration.

sectors.trend: Renters' financial stress, interest rate pincer, and unemployment rise squeezing household budgets. Star casino suspension weighs on gaming. EV adoption (Bentley $325k) signals premium segment only.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, and gaming names face headwinds. Consumer staples (WOW.AX, COL.AX) relatively defensive.

sectors.trend: Global AI momentum (Nvidia, AMD, Salesforce) continues but limited ASX direct exposure. Medicare breach prompts AI safety legislation debate. CSL remains defensive anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SXW.AX, W1.AX benefit from defensive flows. AI safety regulation could create compliance costs for health-tech.

key_themes: RBA hiking into recession risk – policy dilemma intensifying
AUD trapdoor weakens import costs but pressures ASX foreign-earning miners
Housing market in advanced correction – 40-year low trajectory
Gold exploration renaissance in WA and West Africa
Energy infrastructure strain from AI/data centre buildout
Household financial stress at multi-year highs
Global AI/tech leadership (US) with limited ASX participation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hiking into rising unemployment – stagflation risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); reduce cyclical exposure; monitor RBA statement for pivot signals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA intervention risk
Underweight residential REITs and builders; monitor credit conditions and NPL data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply bottleneck from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO capacity warnings; favour energy producers with long-term offtake contracts

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Small-cap dilution from $2.7B cap raise wave
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid recent cap-raise names; focus on cash-flow-positive juniors with limited dilution

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical risk – China/US tensions, Trump policy shifts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from China-revenue exposure; monitor iron ore and LNG contract pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration juniors with strong assay results
opportunities.rationale: Aurum 155g/t and Zenith six-for-six in WA signal undervalued resource potential; gold benefits from AUD weakness and global uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Stagflation risk and household stress favour defensive cash-flow names; CSL and Woolworths provide income and resilience

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy/infrastructure exposure for data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural energy demand from AI buildout supports long-term revenue for producers and grid operators

defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth losing week, 40-year house price decline trajectory, and rising unemployment signal prolonged downturn in cyclicals

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce foreign-currency revenue exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD trapdoor move increases volatility; domestic-revenue companies less exposed to FX swings
$2.7B dilution wave creates overhang; wait for post-raise stabilisation before entry

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. Fourth consecutive losing week with rising bond yields and AUD weakness suggests further downside. RBA hawkish bias despite unemployment surge limits rate-cut hopes. Expect ASX 200 to test lower supports. Gold juniors and defensives outperform.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if RBA pivots within 2–3 quarters. Housing correction nearing completion could support a 2027 recovery. Gold and energy infrastructure themes offer structural upside. AI/tech remains a global tailwind but limited ASX participation.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (next meeting)
Australian CPI and unemployment data releases
AUD/USD trajectory and potential RBA intervention
Iron ore and LNG contract pricing (China demand)
Housing credit data and NPL trends
Energy policy response to data centre demand
US Fed policy and global risk sentiment
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
AEMO energy demand and capacity warnings
